title: 3D generation joins the API
summary:
3D generation and PKCE login landed alongside clearer Pollen checkout, expanded community-model access and tidier model routing.

A Quest contribution added GLB generation with Trellis 2 for image-to-3D and Rodin 2.5 for image-to-3D or text-to-3D. The API supports blocking requests, asynchronous jobs and model discovery; Enter’s catalog now shows 3D models with per-generation prices.

Apps can use an OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE instead of receiving a key in the callback. The work also adds authorization-server discovery and userinfo, while the SDK’s device authorization flow moves to the shared token endpoint.

Pollen packs and auto top-ups now include a 3.5% plus $0.30 service fee, rounded up to the nearest cent, with applicable tax added at checkout. Purchase screens show the pack-plus-fee amount before tax, invoices separate the fee, and the terms and refund policy reflect the change.

highlights.title: Images become 3D models
highlights.text: Generate GLB files with Trellis 2 from reference images, or use Rodin 2.5 with images or text. [Browse 3D models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: 3D generation API
highlights.text: Request a GLB directly with `GET /3d/{prompt}`, or submit an asynchronous generation and poll for its result. Model discovery is available at `GET /3d/models`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: PKCE login for apps
highlights.text: Third-party apps can use an OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE, plus authorization-server discovery and userinfo, to connect users without putting an API key in the callback. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
